name: Mayoeru Futari to Sekai no Subete Love Heaven 300%
original_name: 迷える2人とセカイのすべて LOVE HEAVEN 300%
source:
This is a mini fandisc for Mayosube with routes for character poll winners Nana and Touka. In Nana’s route, Nana comes to live with him when all the other girls (and Subaru) go on vacation under the guise of recovering from their rejections. Touka’s route is a mix of seven stories, both serious and ecchi. There’s even one where she becomes a loli! The H scenes are 300% more ero! 300% more ero!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/05/17/may-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Mayosube的迷你同人光盘，其中包含角色投票获胜者Nana和Touka的路线。在娜娜的路线中，当所有其他女孩（和昴）以从拒绝中恢复过来的幌子去度假时，娜娜来和他住在一起。Touka的路线混合了七个故事，既有严肃的故事，也有悲惨的故事。甚至还有变萝莉的！H场景更加色情300%！性欲增加300%！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/05/17/may-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
